messages:
incident_bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for tenant=stella-corp in eu-west-4 dedicated pool. p95 420ms -> 1800ms, p99 1.2s -> 4.6s. Error ratio 0.8%. Paging oncall.
kaisa_oncall: oncall here, seeing the page. pulling dashboards now.
eli_sre: I have the stream open — tailing node logs, seeing KV cache thrash and OOMs on one host: dedicated-eu-west-4-03.
jonathan_prod: confirming customer impact: Stella (enterprise) reports timeouts. CS looped in. @emma_cs can you confirm user-visible symptoms?
emma_cs: customer reporting search and chat timeouts for some users, started ~10m ago. They're on version 2025-02 pinned. They've escalated to priority-high. I've told them we're investigating.
kaisa_oncall: steps: 1) isolate noisy tenant, 2) scale pool or failover warm spare, 3) if needed evict and move to temp pool, 4) notify customer with ETA.
devin_runtime: quick check: dedicated-eu-west-4 has 6 replicas, one host running ~95% GPU mem, repeated OOM backoffs. Kernel logs show matmul allocate failures.
eli_sre: hypothesis: model cache growth from long-context sessions created KV pressure. We'll try to offload that tenant's traffic to a spare pool and pin caches.
kaisa_oncall: @devin_runtime can you run an eviction into quarantine pool (quarantine-eu-west) while we scale? If not, do targeted tenant-shield.
devin_runtime: running command now:
```
rictl tenant-evict --tenant stella-corp --from-pool dedicated-eu-west-4 --to-pool quarantine-eu-west --reason "KV-cache thrash" --force
```
ops_bot: Command accepted. Eviction job id=evict-7315002468-01 queued.
devin_runtime: eviction in progress — moving 1200 active sessions. Will drain gracefully, 60s max per connection.
eli_sre: while that runs, scaling up pool replicas +2 to absorb background load:
```
rictl pool scale --pool dedicated-eu-west-4 --replicas 8
```
ops_bot: Scale started, new replicas provisioning. ETA ~3m.
kaisa_oncall: grabbing synthetic run now to validate latency on non-Stella traffic.
jonathan_prod: flag — if eviction fails or quarantine shows same behaviour, we need to evict completely and route Stella to hosted fallback (with consent). Prep a rollback play.
emma_cs: I've drafted a short customer message: "We're actively mitigating an infrastructure issue impacting latency. We're isolating your traffic to a quarantined pool; short interruptions possible. Will update in 15m." Approve?
kaisa_oncall: send that. mark as incident-high and create status page update.
eli_sre: eviction job reports 90% sessions moved, remaining 120 sessions on a single failing host. I'm going to drain and ban that host temporarily.
devin_runtime: banning host dedicated-eu-west-4-03 from scheduler:
```
rictl host-banish --host dedicated-eu-west-4-03 --reason "OOM/kv-thrash"
```
ops_bot: Host ban applied. Scheduler will stop assigning new work. Existing connections being drained.
eli_sre: p95 back down to 210ms, p99 320ms. Error ratio dropped to 0.1%. Looks much better.
kaisa_oncall: Nice. Keep the quarantine in read-only mode for an hour, then we can plan a controlled migration to a patched runtime.
jonathan_prod: action items: 1) run RCA from runtime team on KV cache growth, 2) add eviction telemetry to runbooks, 3) follow up with customer and offer a dedicated maintenance window to move to patched version. Assigning tasks.
emma_cs: customer acknowledged message, appreciates the proactive touch. They've asked for post-incident report and timeline for patch.
devin_runtime: created ticket INF-8472 for runtime patch and memory caps per-tenant. Linking here.
eli_sre: documenting commands used and timeline in incident doc.
kaisa_oncall: closing active war-room for now — monitoring for 30m. If p99 stays <500ms, we'll transition to async RCA. Thanks all :thumbsup:
